thread:
Alex K: paging: trend spike in /v1/generate errors and 5xxs starting ~18:07 UTC. Seeing increased tail latency too. customer reports from two high-traffic tenants. paging oncall.

Oncall Pager: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: 5xx rate > 3% for 10m on prod cluster-rw-us. Escalating to SRE.

SRE Bot: incident created: INC-2026-4812, severity: P1, runbook: inference-degradation. Linked: dashboard /dash/cluster-rw-us/errors, logs query id=qx9r.

Maria S: I'm on it. Quick ask — is this one region/cluster or multi-region?

Alex K: initially only cluster-rw-us. Metrics for eu and apac look normal.

Jia W: ingesting logs. One quick log sample: ``ERROR inference: failed to allocate KV cache shard=12 model=redwood-1-14b quantized=true oom_retry=true``. Multiple OOM-ish traces but also some 502s from nginx.

Luis R: I can confirm a sharp increase in streaming timeout errors at the LB layer around same time: ``upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream``. Could be backend processes crashing or heavy GC.

Maria S: Customer impact check: which tenants hitting errors? Alex can you correlate 5xx by tenant id?

Alex K: early look: 2 tenants account for ~70% of error traffic — tenant-a (PLG chat app) and tenant-c (enterprise). Both doing long-context streaming.

Jia W: adding hypothesis tracker in-thread: H1: KV cache shard pressure due to long contexts causing OOMs -> crashes -> 502s. H2: recent kernel patch on host pool rolled earlier today causing network resets. H3: model quantization path regression causing memory blowups for >8k tokens.

Maria S: good. Assign owners: H1 -> Jia W + Luis R, H2 -> Deploy Bot (infra team) + Alex K, H3 -> Maria S + Product Ops.

Oncall Pager: Handoff note: next oncall in 30m is Luis. Paging oncall now and will handoff live.

Deploy Bot: Rollout history: hostpool/flex-nodes patch 2026-03-15T09:40:12Z -> 30% rolled. Canary shows 2/3 nodes healthy, but a partial restart batch executed at 17:55 UTC. No automatic rollback triggered.

Luis R: I'm joining. Can someone drop the specific log query? Jia?

Jia W: logs query: ``service:inference cluster:rw-us level:error | parse "shard=*" as shard | stats count() by shard, pod``. Early output shows shard 12 and 7 spike.

Alex K: I pushed a quick dashboard with error rates by pod and by shard. Link /dash/err-shards. Pod inference-gg-12 restarted 8 times since 18:10. Core dump present on one.

Maria S: Customer comms: Product Ops - can you start drafting a short status message for affected tenants that we're investigating and recommended workaround (shorten context, reduce streaming)?

Product Ops: drafting now. Will include ETA for next update in 30m.

Jia W: testing a scoped mitigation: disable KV caching for long-context sessions on rw-us cluster (hotfix toggle). This should reduce memory pressure but increase token cost. Plan: flip toggle on one AZ for 5m then expand if stable. Anyone object?

Luis R: agree. Prefer AZ-scoped so we can measure. I'll watch pod restarts and OOM counts.

Alex K: go for it. Make sure to tag the change in the incident log.

Deploy Bot: feature-flag toggled: kv-cache-longcontext=false on rw-us-az1 at 18:34 UTC by Jia W.

Jia W: applying canary now. Observing immediate drop in OOM traces on those pods. 502s decreased from 4.2% -> 1.1% within 6m on az1.

Maria S: early signal looks promising. Keep AZ1 toggled, do not expand yet. Capture baseline metrics for 15m.

Luis R: also starting a controlled revert test for today's hostpool roll: repro plan to roll back the 17:55 batch on one node and observe network reset counters. Assign to Alex K.

Alex K: starting node rollback on rp-node-17 at 18:42. Will coordinate with Deploy Bot.

Deploy Bot: rollback initiated on rp-node-17, operation id rb-9812. ETA ~4m.

Alex K: rolled back. Network reset counters on rp-node-17 decreased compared to sibling nodes. But other nodes still show elevated resets.

Jia W: hypothesis update: H1 now has high confidence — KV cache pressure was a major driver (score: medium-high). H2 still plausible since host roll coincided, but H2 seems secondary. H3 (quantization regression) not supported by traces — memory blowups show continuous allocation growth, not quant path asserts. Lowering H3 confidence to low.

Maria S: Can we quantify customer impact? Alex, Product Ops — what's the percent of requests failing for tenant-a/tenant/c during this window?

Alex K: tenant-a peak error rate 6.2% between 18:08-18:20, tenant-c 8.9%. After kv-cache toggle on az1, tenant-a dropped to 1.9% (on az1) and tenant-c to 2.7%. Overall cluster error dropped from 4.8% to 2.3%.

Product Ops: comms update queued: "Investigating elevated errors impacting streaming and long-context requests in us-west. Scoped mitigation applied; some tenants see improvement. Next update in 30m."

Luis R: next steps (in-thread action items): - Monitor remaining AZs for similar improvement (owner: Jia W) - Run full rollback of 17:55 hostpool batch if network resets remain high (owner: Alex K) - Prepare controlled revert test for kv-cache toggle to measure perf impact (owner: Maria S) - Create short-lived rate limiter advice for affected tenants (owner: Product Ops)

Jia W: monitoring — az2/az3 OOMs still present but lower frequency. I'll start expanding kv-cache toggle to az2 after 20m observation if stable.

Maria S: we should also capture heap profiles from one of the failing pods before any more restarts. Jia, can you snapshot pprof from inference-gg-12?

Jia W: capturing heap profile now: /artifacts/INC-2026-4812/pprof/inference-gg-12-18_45.pb.gz. Uploaded.

Alex K: grabbing coredump, will upload to incident artifacts.

Deploy Bot: ops note: rollback of hostpool batch completed on rp-node-19 and rp-node-21 at 19:02 UTC. No further automatic restarts in those nodes.

Luis R: mid-incident hypothesis update: H1 dominant. Plan to keep kv-cache disabled for long contexts until we ship a patch to avoid unbounded shard allocations. Work item to implement upper-bounds on per-shard size opened: GH-cc/infra#4021 (owner: Maria S).

Maria S: scheduling a quick post-mortem sync at 21:00 UTC to pin root cause and RCA leads. Please add any outstanding logs/traces to the incident thread.

Product Ops: sending initial customer update now.

Oncall Pager: handoff note: Luis taking next oncall shift at 19:30 UTC. Luis — you'll get a follow-up with active mitigations and artifact links.

Luis R: acknowledged. I'll watch rollout and decide whether to expand kv-cache toggle.

Alex K: final note for now — maintain canary and keep artifact uploads current. I'll update thread when rollback test completes across remaining nodes.

SRE Bot: incident status change: mitigated->partial; next update due in 30m.

Maria S: thanks team. Great rapid response.

Product Ops: draft for customers posted. Will attach follow-up with mitigation details and ETA for full fix in the postmortem.
